sidebar.title: BioPlatgesMet
sidebar.description:
The AMB Beach Service, the Institute of Marine Sciences – CSIC and the Metropolis Institute participate in the European GUARDEN project (Horizon Europe Programme) together with 15 other partners from 8 countries. BioPlatgesMet is the name of its development in the field of metropolitan beaches.

Its main objective is to protect the biodiversity of metropolitan beaches, preserve the benefits that nature brings to society and raise citizen awareness of its importance.

data_source.text:
The data available in this Monitoring Dashboard is a visualization of the information collected through MINKA, voluntarily, by the participants of the BioPlatgesMet project. They can be consulted at: [https://minka-sdg.org/projects/bioplatgesmet](https://minka-sdg.org/projects/bioplatgesmet).

MINKA is a citizen observation platform developed by ICM-CSIC. It is an infrastructure that offers tools and services to promote citizen participation and the collection of data on biodiversity and environmental parameters. It allows sharing geolocated observations of biodiversity and environmental variables to contribute to the monitoring of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). It is designed to facilitate collaboration between citizens, the academic community, public administration, industry and other sectors.

The data collected with MINKA can be downloaded through the **Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF)**. If you want to download the dataset, you can do so through the link: [https://www.gbif.org/dataset/9a51436f-3c81-4b1a-92d6-6f0c1dbb05de](https://www.gbif.org/dataset/9a51436f-3c81-4b1a-92d6-6f0c1dbb05de).

Communicating to our users about the use of their data is essential to encourage their participation and recognize the voluntary work they carry out. If you use this dashboard, MINKA data and/or the BioPlatgesMet project, please consider the **MINKA Data Citation Guide** available at: [https://zenodo.org/records/14216256](https://zenodo.org/records/14216256).

Citing the data and informing us about its use is key for the community to continue participating. Thank you for your contribution.

**Data source:** MINKA Citizen Observatory. MINKA API Data Feed. EMBIMOS research group, Institut de Ciències del Mar (ICM-CSIC). Barcelona, Spain. Available at: [https://minka-sdg.org](https://minka-sdg.org).
